warnings.why: A Gini index of 23 for India in 2023 is implausibly low and inconsistent with robust empirical studies and national consumption/income surveys showing significantly higher inequality.
A Gini index of 24.7 is exceptionally low for a Pacific island nation with high remittance dependency and geographic fragmentation, usually pointing to data limitations or survey incomparability.

policy: model memory is advisory; unsupported suspicions cannot overrule official data
